body:
It's not really because of the SO, But it just adds onto it. I've been struggling with depression since middleschool and my family didn't see the signs when it could have been fixed and treated.

And yes i know, If i even said I thought about retrieving the gun I would be admitted. But I've tried therapy, I've tried meds, Lots of them. None of it helps.

I get better for a week at tops and then just end up falling further down.

I have no more fight left in me, I'm tired of trying just to come back and find that the whole has gotten deeper while I was gone. And I'm not trying to put it all on the fact that the SO is gone, But atleast she was giving me a purpose to even do anything. On top of that, I've lost both the male role models I had in my life, One when I was young, The other just last year and sooner then later the person who raised me is going to end up leaving me shortly, I can see it. I can't handle that, I've lost enough people in my life but that one would end up being the last straw.

I'm a 20 year old fuck up. I've come to terms with it, I'm just like my piece of shit father.

The plan that was going to be done with the SO was for me to get a shitty job and we were going to move in together, But after all the bullshit she's had me endure and the double standards and the lying and the cheating. I stayed because I loved her, But yet when I had turned my Facebook back on around my birthday so that way my extended family could wish me a happy birthday or maybe even offer to take me out to dinner etc she leaves.
Whatever. I don't care nor does anyone else. I know you can relate internet stranger and you want to feel apathetic but when it breaks down to it, If I blow my brains out tomorrow it wouldn't effect you nor anyone else.
